conditions: Nondegenerate Euclidean triangle with positive side lengths satisfying strict triangle inequalities; s=(a+b+c)/2.

evidence: Let C be the included angle between sides a and b. The area K is ab sin(C)/2, and cos(C)=(a^2+b^2-c^2)/(2ab). Therefore 16K^2=4a^2b^2-(a^2+b^2-c^2)^2=(a+b+c)(a+b-c)(a-b+c)(-a+b+c)=16s(s-c)(s-b)(s-a). All factors are positive by the triangle inequalities, so take the positive square root.

Reference cross-check of the standard relationship: https://openstax.org/books/precalculus-2e/pages/8-key-equations. Checked 2026-11-27. Proposed maintainer approval; not independent human certification.
